name: postgresql_extensions
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_available_extensions WHERE name = 'pg_trgm') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_trgm') AS ok;
recovery: If application fails, the transaction rolls back automatically. After successful application, do not edit or drop the extension ad hoc; any required correction must be a new reviewed forward migration after checking dependent approved objects.
